## Background

I'm Priyadharshini Balaji, currently pursuing an **MSc in Business Analytics** at **Dublin City University** (DCU). I hold a **Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology**, which gave me a strong foundation in programming, databases, and systems thinking before I moved into analytics.

## What drives me

I'm fascinated by the way data can change decisions. A well-placed chart can shift a strategy; a well-designed dashboard can save hours of guesswork. My MSc has been pushing me from *describing* data to *predicting* with it — statistical modelling, machine learning, and communicating findings to non-technical audiences.

## Goals

Over the next year I want to:

1. **Deepen my machine learning fundamentals** — especially classification, clustering, and time series.
2. **Build a portfolio of end-to-end analytics projects** that real people can interact with (this site is step one).
3. **Secure an analyst role** where I can combine business context with rigorous technical work.

## Beyond analytics

When I'm not staring at Jupyter notebooks, I enjoy exploring Dublin, reading, and tinkering with little side projects that usually start as "this should take an hour" and end up taking a weekend.
